tool_mode: fixed demo providers; real model and PostgreSQL
latency_scope: NewExecution + Start + final Run persistence; excludes migrations/fixture setup, HTTP/SSE/browser and seeded-plan preparation
notes: Serial execution, 3 repeats per case; no p95 claim from this small sample.
Token usage comes only from provider response Usage; nil is missing, never estimated as zero.
Model calls count Generate invocations; hidden SDK HTTP retries are not separately counted.
Travel is non-streaming; first_event_ms is first platform event, not time to first token.
Case modify_activity is seeded through Service before timing; seed revision count is reported.
All runs use fresh random schemas and cold application query caches; provider prompt cache is not controlled.
